{{Quote|Rise, Sisters. Undead sisters, rise from your sleep. The time has come. Awaken. You have been called upon.|Old Daka's resurrection spell|<ref name="Massacre" />}}
'''Daka''', also known as '''Old Daka''', was a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and a [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] successfully [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|assaulted and destroyed]] the [[Nightsister fortress]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Daka! As the oldest and wisest of us, I need you to resurrect our fallen Sisters.|[[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="Massacre" />}}
The oldest and wisest of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] clan, Old Daka's knowledge of the arcane [[Dathomir Magic|magicks]] was unprecedented. She resided in the [[Nightsister fortress]], the settlement of the united covens under [[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]. Her secret lair was the [[Hidden Cave/Legends|Hidden Cave]], a place that could only be entered with a spell.<ref name="Massacre" />

When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] launched a devastating attack on Dathomir, and the Nightsisters were outnumbered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces, Mother Talzin retreated into the depths of the witches' lair and called upon Old Daka for help. Daka used an [[Chant of Resurrection/Legends|ancient incantation]] to summon the [[Army of the Dead/Legends|dead]] from the Nightsisters' graveyard, bolstering their number with [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] hordes.<ref name="Massacre" />

[[File:DeathOldDaka.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Old Daka's death at the hands of General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]]]Despite the intervention of Daka's magical aide-de-camp, the Separatist forces ended up outmatching the Sisters. Old Daka was killed by Grievous with a [[Shiak|stab]] through the stomach, resulting in the destruction of every Nightsister [[Zombie/Legends|Zombie]]&mdash;the spell would only last as long as its caster was active. With Daka's [[Death/Legends|death]], the coven had lost one of its most knowledgeable sisters, but [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] had been able to escape and flee far away on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], seeking out vengeance.<ref name="Massacre" />

==Powers and abilities==
Old Daka was considered extremely wise, even by high standards. Her mastering of the Chant of Resurrection ought to have been unique, as even Talzin (though a powerful [[Shaman of the Nightsisters]]) asked of her to use the spell against the droid armies. However, Daka wasn't strong enough to defend herself against Grievous and keep the spell active at the same time.<ref name="Massacre" />

==Behind the scenes==
The only appearance of the witch Daka to date was in ''[[Massacre]]'', the nineteenth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]], in which the character was introduced and killed off.<ref name="Massacre" />

In the [[2012]] ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', it was revealed that shamans acted as a conduit and a mouthpiece of the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|Spirits]], which explains their eerie voice.<ref name="BookOfSith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
